description: Run a strictly read-only, non-destructive 6-phase deep security audit on a live web application URL (Next.js, Vite, Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Supabase, Firebase): checks real TLS port 443 cert & CNAME subdomain takeover, unpacks up to 24 full JS bundles (<=2.5MB each) across 52 secret patterns, runs 28 SPA-filtered sensitive endpoint probes (GraphQL introspection, .env, .git, SourceMaps, Open Redirect, CORS), audits Supabase PostgREST RLS (up to 20 tables) & Firebase RTDB/Firestore read rules, parses Mozilla Observatory headers/CSP AST/HSTS/cookies, and matches passive framework CVEs (e.g. CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48757).

mode.description: Scan depth: 'deep' runs all 6 phases (~6-16s); 'fast' runs quick triage (<5s).

url.description: Public HTTPS web application URL to audit (e.g. 'https://yourapp.vercel.app'). Only audit apps you own or are authorized to test.

name: audit_web_app_security
title: VibeShield v7.0 — 6-Phase Web & AI App Security Audit
